The '''heavy assault blaster rifle''' was a large [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. It was designed to give a single person enough firepower to take out a whole squad of enemies. It was restricted to military use under [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] law.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" />

The heavy assault blaster rifle operated in autofire-only mode, that is, it fired multiple shots in rapid succession at a greater area but at the cost of accuracy.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" />

[[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Morrigan Corde]] carried a heavy assault blaster rifle on difficult missions, such as when she broke in to the [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to rescue [[Cade Skywalker]].<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" />
